more_info.banned_in:
Approved in the EU.
Approved in the US.
US food use is subject to the listed CFR provisions and their conditions, checked in 2026.
more_info.overview: Aspartame is used as a sweetener in food. Its technological role is to provide sweetness.
more_info.uses: EU permissions include meal replacement for weight control as referred to in Commission Regulation (EU) no 432/2012, flavoured drinks, flavoured fermented milk products including heat-treated products, edible ices. These permissions depend on the food category and its conditions of use.
more_info.side_effects:
Reported food-use estimates were below the limit in the 2026 assessment.
The reviewed evidence did not identify a new genotoxicity concern or a better dose for deriving the limit.
more_info.precautions: US labels must identify phenylalanine for people with phenylketonuria, because aspartame supplies phenylalanine.
